customrecordcustomfield.help: R net revenue before tax, G estimated gross profit (revenue - line cost estimate), Q quantity sold.

customrecordcustomfield.help: R sales rep on the transaction, T sales team by contribution (falls back to the sales rep), F custom employee body field.

customrecordcustomfield.help: Body field id holding the credited employee when the credit source is F.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Cửa sổ tính
customrecordcustomfield.description: M monthly, Q quarter to date, Y year to date. Q / Y pay the window commission minus what earlier periods of the window already paid (true-up).
customrecordcustomfield.help: M monthly, Q quarter to date, Y year to date. Q / Y pay the window commission minus what earlier periods of the window already paid (true-up).

customrecordcustomfield.description: Credit memos of the period reduce the base of the credited employee.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Credit memos of the period reduce the base of the credited employee.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Truy thu sau (ngày)
customrecordcustomfield.description: Trigger I: the unpaid part of an invoice still open N days after its date is deducted in the period it falls due. 0 or empty = off.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Trigger I: the unpaid part of an invoice still open N days after its date is deducted in the period it falls due. 0 or empty = off.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Loại dòng bỏ qua
customrecordcustomfield.description: Comma separated item types to skip. Default TaxItem,ShipItem,Subtotal,Description,EndGroup,Group. Discount lines count because they reduce net revenue.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Comma separated item types to skip. Default TaxItem,ShipItem,Subtotal,Description,EndGroup,Group. Discount lines count because they reduce net revenue.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Loại thu nhập lương
customrecordcustomfield.description: Payroll earning type code that receives the payable commission.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Payroll earning type code that receives the payable commission.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Ngưỡng % đạt tối thiểu (%)
customrecordcustomfield.description: Percent, 80 = 80%. Below this attainment the sales based components pay 0 (milestone bonuses keep their own thresholds).
customrecordcustomfield.help: Percent, 80 = 80%. Below this attainment the sales based components pay 0 (milestone bonuses keep their own thresholds).

customrecordcustomfield.help: After adjustments, before the draw. Empty = no cap.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Ứng trước (draw)
customrecordcustomfield.description: N none, R recoverable draw (paid up to the draw amount, recovered later), G guaranteed minimum (not recovered).
customrecordcustomfield.help: N none, R recoverable draw (paid up to the draw amount, recovered later), G guaranteed minimum (not recovered).
